findings.impact: Cancelled old selection can still replace the current note; retained inactive-page state can be mutated by a stale completion. Real native picker and BFCache timing are not asserted by VM.
findings.fix: Invalidate import generation on a new chooser start/cancel/newfile/pagehide and track page active state. Apply only when generation+edit revision+active state are current. Keep normal valid-import and newer-import behavior.
findings.retest: Delayed valid/rejected read→new dialog/cancel/no-file/pagehide/pageshow/newfile; no stale state or status update. Verify native picker/back routes separately.

expected.text: あいだの設計をノートに追加しました。

findings.impact: After selecting a work, the successful selection message changes to an obsolete file error even though that import should have been discarded. The catch path lacks the successful-resolution edit protection.
findings.fix: Guard catch with generation, active state, captured edit revision and status revision; preserve newer action status. If a discarded-read notice is needed, emit it only while no newer status exists.
findings.retest: For all input fields, work add/remove and reset, reject older File.text after the action and retain both current draft and newest status.

findings.title: NoJSの「このページを印刷」経路が印刷CSSで内容を隠す
locations: site/index.html:40 (NoJS notice promises this page can be printed)
findings.evidence: NoJS notice says this page can be printed, but print CSS hides the notice noscript, all main static portfolio sections, and brief section heading. The interactive note workspace remains .js-only display:none!important without .js-ready. The static publication.html has its own readable manuscript route.
findings.impact: The documented JavaScript-disabled fallback points to an index print state whose meaningful content is hidden by the source CSS.
findings.fix: Preserve static text/art/notice for NoJS print, or explicitly direct NoJS users to the static publication.html printing route and remove the misleading index-page print promise.
findings.retest: With JavaScript disabled, inspect index and publication print previews. Confirm useful content, headings and fallback instructions survive; retain normal note-only print behavior with JS.
